changelog: Good Trade Gold PRO V8.02 - Universal On-Chart Graphic Anti-Collision Matrix, Subwindow 1 Geometry Precision & Zero-Overflow Card Protection: 1) Fibonacci vs Plan Anti-Collision: Automatically flips Fibo badges to the left of the candlestick (-14 bars) if within 22 pixels of any active Plan target (Entry/SL/TP1/TP2/TP3), eliminating triple-text overlap. 2) ABCD Wave Staggering: Shifts Point D projection badge to wave.timeB + 6 bars when Plan TP2 is active, clearing the forward margin for the TP2 badge. Point C anchored cleanly inside OTE box. 3) Institutional BSL/SSL Forward Offset: Advanced to +7 bars into empty margin to avoid colliding with Point B swing highs. 4) Subwindow 1 Geometry Refinement: Live aqua Bid line centered on Candle 0 and PA badge vertically centered. 5) Dashboard Card 1 Overflows Eliminated: Compacted Smart Action, Samurai Macro, Candlestick (PA), and Market Advice Line 2.
